title: 第38章 逆流星潮第37章 星火议事
lines: 话音刚落，整座议会大殿猛地一颤。
不是爆炸。
地底先拱起一记闷沉的金属撕裂，紧接着，王座殿方向传来一串尖锐共振。那声响沿着黑铁梁柱一路刮过来，穹顶上的星辰巨龙投影当场扭曲，龙翼边缘裂开暗紫纹路，龙尾扫得整片星图乱晃。
梅洛手里的卷宗掉了一本。
“又来？”
显曜已经抬杖转身。
“熔炉室。”
洛晖一步跳下高台，边走边扣紧肩甲上的星焰纹章。
“雷昂，清空王座殿外环。梅洛，封议会侧门。绮兰，地面层交给你。”
一群人还没来得及追问，地底第二声共振已经顶上来。殿柱间的星火照明一明一灭，契约镜面上全是乱跳的蓝紫光条。洛晖冲进王座殿长廊时，地下三层的警戒晶同时炸亮，红纹一圈圈往上翻。
熔炉室门口已经乱了。
三台星火凝聚器烧得发白，外壳开裂，药剂合成台的一排银管抖得直响。贝莎正踩着一地碎晶冲向总阀，抬手一扳，药剂管道“咔”地合死，另一只手把两名研究员往外推。
“别站着，搬药剂，搬抑制网，快！”
洛晖冲到门前，往里一看，眼皮都跳了一下。
中央熔炉的七枚星槽残壳全在震，炉壁一圈圈暗紫波纹往外推，第一层星纹防护阵已经被撕开一个缺口。星槽缝里喷出的不是普通星火，是粘着暗紫污痕的旧核逆流，正沿炉底四散，烧得地砖全是蛛网裂痕。
显曜扑到监测台前，十几枚记录晶齐齐亮起。曲线疯狂上拱，频率一跳一跳，七息一转。
显曜盯了两眼，手都停了一瞬。
“不是乱流。”
“废话，这玩意儿都快唱上拍子了。”洛晖抬手一按门框，原初星纹顺着掌心铺开，“人撤完没有？”
“底层还剩一组抑制网研究员。”
洛晖转头喝了一声。
“全员撤出地面层以上。骑士团外环布防，准备星潮挡。”
雷昂带着一队骑士刚赶到，闻言连停都不停，转身就分人。
“二队跟我守门，三队去上层楼梯口。谁今天手抖，回头自己写检讨，别让我代笔。”
贝莎拖着一箱稳定药剂往外跑，路过洛晖时把一卷备用抑制网塞进他手里。
“别逞英雄，手臂再烧烂我不给你缝第二次。”
“放心，我这人零件珍贵。”
话还没落，熔炉里第一轮真正的冲击就到了。
轰地一顶。
整道门框都往外鼓，暗紫星潮从裂开的第一层防护阵里撞出来。洛晖脚下一沉，双手前推，星潮挡在门口猛然撑开。蓝金色的挡壁刚成形，暗紫逆流已经狠狠拍了上来。
砰！
门外长廊两侧的抑制灯一排排熄灭。
洛晖肩甲上的纹章亮起六道蓝金纹路，星辰骑士投影在门前浮现，举盾顶住第二波压力。可就在第十息，投影肩甲边缘猛地裂开一条细缝，整面骑士盾往后滑了半寸。
“见鬼，偏偏这时候犯老毛病。”洛晖咬牙往前顶，“十息延迟，你是真会挑日子。”
旧核逆流压在星潮挡上，顺着边缘往外啃。暗紫污痕贴着挡壁爬上他的手臂，掌心那道旧火痕一路烧到小臂。胸前铜星坠烫得发狠，银链都贴着皮肉发热。
显曜扯开备用抑制网，反手甩进门口两侧卡槽。
“撑三息。”
content_en:
As soon as he finished speaking, the entire parliament hall trembled suddenly.
Not an explosion.
The ground first arched with a dull metal tear, and then, a series of sharp resonances came from the direction of the throne room. The sound blew all the way along the black iron beams. The star dragon projection on the dome was distorted on the spot. Dark purple lines cracked on the edges of the dragon's wings, and the dragon's tail swept the entire star map.
A file fell from Mello's hand.
"Again?"
Xian Yao had already raised his staff and turned around.
"The Furnace Room."
Luo Hui jumped off the high platform in one step, fastening the star flame emblem on his shoulder armor as he walked.
"Leon, clear the outer ring of the throne room. Mello, seal the side door of the parliament. Qilan, leave the ground floor to you."
Before a group of people had time to ask questions, the second resonance sound from the ground had already come up. The sparks between the palace pillars flickered on and off, and the contract mirror was filled with streaks of blue-violet light that danced randomly. When Luo Hui rushed into the corridor of the throne room, the warning crystals on the three underground floors exploded at the same time, and red lines turned up in circles.
The door to the furnace room was in chaos.
The three Spark Concentrators burned white, their shells cracked, and a row of silver tubes on the potion synthesis station shook loudly. Bertha was stepping on a pile of broken crystals and rushing towards the main valve. She raised her hand and pulled the medicine pipe shut with a click. She pushed the two researchers out with her other hand.
"Don't stand still, move the potion, move the suppression net, quickly!"
Luo Hui rushed to the door, looked inside, and his eyelids twitched.
The remaining shells of the seven star slots in the central furnace were all shaking. Circles of dark purple ripples on the furnace wall were pushing outward, and a gap had been torn open in the first layer of the star pattern protective array. What spewed out from the cracks in the star slot was not an ordinary spark, but a backflow of old cores with dark purple stains, which were scattered along the bottom of the furnace, burning the floor tiles with cobweb cracks.
Xian Yao rushed to the monitoring station, and more than a dozen recording crystals lit up. The curve arches up crazily, the frequency jumps one after another, and the seven breaths rotate one after another.
Xian Yao stared at it twice and stopped his hands for a moment.
"It's not turbulence."
"Nonsense, this thing is almost on time." Luo Hui raised his hand and pressed the door frame, and the original star pattern spread along the palm of his hand, "Have the people evacuated yet?"
"There is still a group of suppression network researchers at the bottom."
"Withdraw."
Luo Hui turned around and shouted.
"All personnel withdraw above the ground level. The Knights set up defenses on the outer ring and prepare to block the star tide."
Leon had just arrived with a group of knights. Hearing the words, he didn't even stop, turned around and separated.
"The second team will guard the door with me, and the third team will go to the upper stairwell. If your hands are shaking today, please go back and write your own review. Don't let me ghostwrite it."
Bertha ran out dragging a box of stabilizing medicine, and when passing by Luo Hui, she put a roll of spare suppression net into his hand.
"Don't try to be a hero. If your arm is burned again, I won't sew it up a second time."
"Don't worry, my parts are precious."
Before he could finish his words, the first real impact in the furnace came.
A bang.
The entire door frame bulged outwards, and a wave of dark purple stars burst out of the cracked first layer of protective formation. Luo Hui's feet dropped and he pushed forward with both hands. Xing Chao blocked the door and suddenly opened it. The blue-gold barrier had just taken shape, and the dark purple countercurrent had already hit it hard.
Bang!
The suppression lights on both sides of the corridor outside the door were turned off in rows.
The coat of arms on Luo Hui's shoulder armor lit up with six blue and gold lines, and the Star Knight's projection appeared in front of the door, raising his shield to withstand the second wave of pressure. But at the tenth breath, a thin crack suddenly opened on the edge of the projection shoulder armor, and the entire knight's shield slid back half an inch.
"Damn it, I'm just making the same old mistake at this time." Luo Hui gritted his teeth and pushed forward, "Ten breaths of delay, you really know how to choose the day."
The old core presses against the star tide barrier and gnaws out along the edge. Dark purple stains climbed up his arms against the wall, and the old fire mark on his palm burned all the way to his forearm. The copper star pendant on his chest was extremely hot, and the silver chain was hot against his skin.
Xian Yao pulled open the backup suppression net and threw it into the slots on both sides of the door.
"Hold for three breaths."
